song_craft: Voice: stotra-address couplets — Abhinavagupta’s own hymn, first person throughout, vocatives load-bearing every verse (row 7). Arc: veneration-by-becoming (v1) → two-step recognition (v2) → fear-denied-suffering-kept (v3) → death defied (v4) → fearlessness finished (v5) → awakening→ingress (v6) → affliction-as-occasion (v7) → rites relativized (v8) → dancing consciousness (v9) → dated seal cooling the world (v10). Recognition performed, not argued. L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: Thus — the great darkness, taken on with becoming, is dispelled by awareness’s rays:
Death, Yama, the Ender, karma-ghosts — Lord, salutation: never shall I fear.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ittham upoḍhabhavanmayasaṃviddīdhitidāritabhūritamisraḥ mṛtyuyamāntakakarmapiśācaiḥ nātha ! namo'stu na jātu bibhemi
notes: upoḍha read ‘taken on’ (against L0 ‘torn-asunder’); tamisra is darkness (against L0 ‘mixed’)

verses.craft: Accomplished-fact → catalogue → salutation → result (order kept); upoḍha/tamisra per NOTE; four-terrors exemplary-or-complete open; bhavanmaya open.
verses.rejected: (a) L0 torn-asunder/mixed → killed by NOTE readings. (b) completing the list → killed by UNC.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'bhavanmaya' (world-becoming) modifies awareness or rays is unresolved.", 'Whether the four terrors are a complete list or exemplary is unresolved.']) / C1 essence / rasa śānta (tranquility) with adbhuta (wonder) / L2+L3 voice
